description: This file declares the SharedStorageImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to shared storage management, including configuration, notification, cache, and limit controls. It defines internal classes, methods for setting/getting/deleting storage data, and event dispatching mechanisms.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing shared storage interfaces, managing storage data, notifications, and events.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation::Store2Notification
classes.description: Internal class implementing notification interface for store changes, forwarding events to parent.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation::Job
classes.description: Dispatch job class for asynchronous event handling related to shared storage events.
